en: Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
zh: 为 `claude plugin install` 新增 `--marketplace <source>`：按需添加 marketplace，遵循与 `claude plugin marketplace add` 相同的策略检查，然后从中安装 plugin
